modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Coordination for inspection of process control and automation systems

pcs.pc_description: prepare a Project Management (PM) schedule for Automotive manufacturing process control system
inspect the process control systems as per schedule
inspect the in-process breakdown of systems
ensure that all the systems are integrated through a computer interface & softwares are updated as per standards
check for electrical circuit continuity & joint's connections as per specifications
prepare the monthly plan for inspection of critical process control

modules.module_title: Repair and carry out the breakdown maintenance

pcs.pc_description: repair the process control and automation systems and replace the spare parts as per the schedule
repair the internal wiring condition, motherboard conditions, software/ hardware malfunctioning, circuit failures etc. and verify the working status
perform the scheduled activities to verify the automotive equipment condition as per the defined sequence
follow the sequence of activities for changing the critical components
use appropriate material handling equipment and tools to carry out the automotive maintenance task
check for software program installations and up gradations
coordinate with the system vendor and arrange for procurement of critical spares
note down the duration for the tasks to improve the scheduling and planning process
coordinate with machine/system/robot vendors and if required, in consultation with sourcing department, procure an AMC for upkeep of the machines/systems/robots etc.
maintain record of spares stored in store- house as per standards
maintain a record of all the automotive vendors in the system
maintain the history of the equipment for the PM/breakdown maintenance activities conducted in log book/history sheets/ERP
prepare the documents required for process control and automation as per the Quality Management System (QMS) requirements
ensure all QMS documents are maintained and easily traceable for future requirements

pcs.pc_description: identify the manufacturing process control requirements as per organization’s plans
compute the individual quantity of the automotive systems to be installed, based on the requirements gathered
plan the procurement and installation process as per standardization & modular arrangements
identify vendor for the procurement of the new system from the company data, share the drawings of the systems along with request for quotes
recognise compatible vendors in case the registered vendors are unable to provide new system requirements.
identify atleast two vendors who fulfill all the automotive product requirements & present them to higher management for selection
conduct trial run of the systems at the vendor's facility
suggest modifications in the new system as per requirements
conduct re-trials with the modified system and present the final report with the management for necessary approvals
approve generation of the purchase order (P.O.) and procure the system in the organization
inspect the components received from vendor, reject the damaged components and procure the fresh component
ensure the correct installation of the new system at the pre-defined location in consultation with the vendor representative
test run the entire system on completion of the installation and identify the discrepancies, if any
implement the countermeasure for discrepancies found and re-run the system
interpret the coding & logic, circuit diagrams of the system received from vendor and document it for future references
record and communicate the progress to the higher management and seek their feedback
guide the team in resolving performance issues, based on feedback received
prepare the system handover documents and share them with all the concerned departments
